heading: Publications & Manuscripts
intro: Manuscripts in preparation and under review. Nothing listed here is a published paper — each entry states its exact status.

items.title: CanvasMind: Multi-Agent Inference-Time RL for Creative AI
items.abstract: A multi-agent creative-AI system in which generative agents co-paint a shared canvas under an inference-time reinforcement-learning layer using best-of-N search, a batched reward model, a persistent UCB1 bandit, and reward-triggered Reflexion self-correction. Agent interactions with misaligned per-agent rewards are modelled as a general-sum game; Shapley-value, empowerment, and Goodhart diagnostics identify and correct four RL defects, lifting composite quality from -0.05 to +1.66 at equal compute across a 4,000-session ablation.

items.title: 3D Feedforward Mapping for Visual Navigation
items.abstract: Benchmarking feedforward 3D mapping models in the DUSt3R / MASt3R / CUT3R lineage against established visual navigation pipelines, evaluating reconstruction quality by downstream navigation performance rather than geometry metrics alone.

items.title: Adaptive Semantic Pipeline for LLM Routing
items.secondaryVenue: With full evaluation scripts, pipeline traces, and interactive demo
items.abstract: An eight-stage LLM routing pipeline that decomposes prompts into a semantic DAG and routes sub-tasks to strong or weak models via a 27-feature LightGBM router with BFS strong-inheritance, reaching 85.66% accuracy and 88.04% F1 while cutting inference cost by roughly 49% at 131 ms mean latency.

items.title: HiGrEC: Hierarchical Classification for Political Question Evasion Detection
items.abstract: A hierarchical classification system over the QEvasion benchmark for SemEval-2026 Task 6 (CLARITY).
